findings.body: The sign-off path checks only whether Autoreview returned findings or a failure reason. `_attempt` records `model:`, `thinking:`, and model-fallback progress lines at review.py:317-323, but `run` never checks the recorded values. A clean report after a fallback can therefore accept sign-off and record the commit even though GPT-6 Sol at xhigh did not run. Refuse unless the reported model and effort positively match the required values.
findings.title: Not done: A strict review guards sign-off

findings.body: An explicitly incomplete Autoreview report can also authorize sign-off. At review.py:335-337, `_attempt` suppresses the incomplete-review reason whenever `scope_rejected_findings` is nonempty. If those findings are P2 or P3, this sign-off check finds no blocking issue and accepts despite `review_status: incomplete` (or exit code 2). The strict gate must require a completed review.
findings.title: Not done: A strict review guards sign-off

findings.body: The acceptance test's Autoreview stub emits no model or effort telemetry, yet the test expects acceptance and asserts only the requested `--model` and `--thinking` arguments. It would still pass if Autoreview ran a fallback model or a lower effort. Add a command-level refusal case that emits fallback or mismatched selection and verifies that the decision remains proposed.
findings.title: Not done: no-fallback sign-off test

findings.body: The product path list comes from the current index. After `git rm --cached app.py` followed by an edit, `app.py` remains in the checkout but disappears from this list. The clone reviews HEAD's older `app.py`, while the path-limited status check at review.py:284-285 misses its staged removal and untracked edited copy. Sign-off can then accept a checkout that differs from the recorded reviewed commit. Compare all product changes against HEAD, including paths removed from the index.
findings.title: Check index-removed product files against the reviewed commit
